## Spatial predictions of mortality and ATE 
### [spaMM] 
#### Create spaMM models.
```{r}

#-------------------------------
# data frames for
# mortality spatial modeling
#-------------------------------
df_all

#--------------------------------------------------------------
# fit spatial models for mortality rate with new binary tx vars,
# isTreated_child: 0=placebo+infant, 1=child
# isTreated_alltx: 0=placebo, 1=infant+child
#--------------------------------------------------------------
fitmort_1to59_child <- create_fitme(df = df_all)
fitmort_1to59_child

# fitmort_1to59_alltx <- create_fitme(df = df_all)
# fitmort_1to59_alltx

```

#### Select spaMM fit for plot_materncor and b_preds.
```{r}

df_s0_child <- fitmort_1to59_child
# df_s0_alltx <- fitmort_1to59_alltx

```

#### Generate and store matern correlation plot.
```{r}

materncorr_s0_child    <- plot_matern_corr(df_s0_child, 
                                           "avenir-materncorr-s0-child")
# materncorr_s0_alltx    <- plot_matern_corr(df_s0_alltx,
#                                            "avenir-materncorr-s0-alltx")

```

#### Create model predictions per treatment arm.
```{r}
#--------------------------------------
# get model predictions on a grid
# (see function in washb-geopair-Functions.R)
#--------------------------------------
b_preds_mort_tx0_child <- get_grid_preds(input_grid = b_boxgrid,
                                         spamm_model_fit = df_s0_child,
                                         tx_group="Control")

summary(b_preds_mort_tx0_child)

b_preds_mort_tx1_child <- get_grid_preds(input_grid = b_boxgrid,
                                         spamm_model_fit = df_s0_child,
                                         tx_group="Treatment")

summary(b_preds_mort_tx1_child)

```

#### Convert predictions into mapping elements.
```{r}
#--------------------------------------------------------------
# convert predicted surface of the mean to a raster to make it 
# a regular set of tiles (rather than points), then to tibble 
# for ggplot2.
# scale prevalence by 100 to be in units of percent (%)
#--------------------------------------------------------------
b_preds_mort_coords_tx0_child <- st_coordinates(b_preds_mort_tx0_child)
b_preds_mort_coords_tx1_child <- st_coordinates(b_preds_mort_tx1_child)

b_preds_mort_raster_tx0_child <- points_to_raster(
  x = b_preds_mort_coords_tx0_child[,1],
  y = b_preds_mort_coords_tx0_child[,2],
  z = b_preds_mort_tx0_child$pred*100,
  mask1 = niger_adm2,
  crop1 = niger_adm2
)

b_preds_mort_raster_tx1_child <- points_to_raster(
  x = b_preds_mort_coords_tx1_child[,1],
  y = b_preds_mort_coords_tx1_child[,2],
  z = b_preds_mort_tx1_child$pred*100,
  mask1 = niger_adm2,
  crop1 = niger_adm2
)

b_preds_mort_raster2_tx0_child <- 
  raster_to_tibble(b_preds_mort_raster_tx0_child)
b_preds_mort_raster2_tx1_child <- 
  raster_to_tibble(b_preds_mort_raster_tx1_child)

```

### [GAMs]
#### Create GAM models.

* Interaction between smoothed (`lon`, `lat`) and factor (`isTreated_child`) variables.
* ATE: -18.5\% (1-exp(-0.20429))

```{r}

# for help:
# 1. "An introduction to mgcViz: visual tools for GAMs":
#   https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/mgcViz/vignettes/mgcviz.html
# 2. "Plotting differences between two 2D smooth effects":
#   https://mfasiolo.github.io/mgcViz/reference/plotDiff.mgcv.smooth.2D.html

# output is log-transformed IRRs
gammort_1to59_child <- gam(n_deaths_1to59 ~
                             isTreated_child +
                             s(lon,lat, by = isTreated_child) + #confirm bs
                             offset(log(pt_year_1to59)),
                           data=df_all,
                           family = poisson,
                           method = "REML")


summary(gammort_1to59_child)
# coef(gammort_1to59_child)
```

#### Convert predictions into mapping elements.
```{r}
gammort_1to59_child <- getViz(gammort_1to59_child)

#plots by treatment arm
plot(sm(gammort_1to59_child, 1)) #Control
plot(sm(gammort_1to59_child, 2)) #Treated

#ATE
pl <- plotDiff(s1 = sm(gammort_1to59_child, 2), 
               s2 = sm(gammort_1to59_child, 1)
               )
pl

# Plot p-values for ATE
pl + l_pvRaster() + l_pvContour()

```
